_comment: Candidate structural themes deliberately NOT declared in pipeline/themes/: promoting them would require asserting exposure signals this pipeline has no honest way to compute. Humanoid robotics has no deployed, revenue-generating per-unit product yet - any theme_exposure_score for it would be scored on speculative language, not the disclosed segment revenue, backlog or customer-concentration evidence every other theme in this screen requires. Quantum computing pure-plays trade on model-based, not commercial, revenue at price-to-sales multiples historically associated with speculative bubbles. Neither is scored, ranked, or included in theme_screen.themes or theme_screen.connectivity. This file is read-only reference data for the frontend's 'Watching, not promoted' note - re-checked and edited by hand, not by a pipeline run.

candidates.why_not_promoted: No public pure-play has a deployed, revenue-generating per-unit product outside internal factory pilots; per-unit costs remain well above what a labor-substitution business case supports. Scoring this theme today would mean measuring filing and transcript language about a future product, not disclosed evidence of a present one - exactly the narrative-only exposure this screen's UNDISCLOSED_EXPOSURE_DISCOUNT and min_signals_required guardrails exist to discount, applied here as a decision not to publish the theme at all rather than to publish it discounted.
candidates.promotion_threshold: Real, disclosed per-unit deployment revenue outside a vendor's own factories - segment revenue or backlog evidence a 10-K would actually carry, not a pilot announcement.

candidates.why_not_promoted: Public pure-plays carry price-to-sales multiples historically associated with speculative rather than commercial valuation, against revenue that is substantially research and government contract work rather than a repeatable commercial product. A theme built on these names today would be measuring hype language, not the kind of disclosed commercial evidence (segment revenue, named customers, backlog) the rest of this screen requires before it will publish a score.
candidates.promotion_threshold: Price-to-sales falling to a range consistent with commercial (not speculative) valuation, on revenue that is disclosed as commercial rather than research/government contract revenue.
